name: Half Mile Drag
creator: Bnuuy
notes: A standing half mile on a prepared strip. No corners, one straight, nothing to tune: the distance alone decides how much of the run is launch, pull and flat-out. The live family has seven more surface variants (t00049–t00054 dirt/gravel/ice/rainy gravel/rainy/snow and t00153 sand) — each is one more line in conditions when wanted; the dirt and gravel ones carry the only real artwork (12dirt.png, 12gravel.jpg).
